notes: Evidence spans two checks: 2 October (0.1.78-3795b4c, the full Figma, Storybook, package and browser check) and 8 October (0.1.78-636f3f5, which re-tested #186 and supersedes the earlier accessibility findings: aria-invalid, aria-required, aria-describedby and the disabled tab order now work). The 8 October check says the 47 px height and the Light-only colours were not re-measured, so the Sources note's height and dark-mode statements rest on the 2 October measurements. The guide copy names no other component to use instead; the avoidWhen item comes from the Storybook MDX as the evidence records it (TextInput or InputSearch, OTP, FormUpload), so it carries no useInstead. The evidence also records two Storybook problems the guide works around: the MDX says the leading and trailing slots are hidden from assistive tech, but on the web they are not, and the trailing-button story uses a plain Pressable rather than a Coin Button. The guide's own In context section keeps the Verify button enabled, but only the Storybook MDX (in the evidence) states that as a general rule. The FormField States mode has a Disabled value that the package never uses (gap).

useWhen.text: Collect one labelled value, such as an account number, with a hint or an error message below it.

from.quote: Use a Form Field to collect one labelled value, such as an account number, with a hint or an error message below it.

avoidWhen.text: The input is unlabelled chrome, a code, or a file: the Storybook docs (as the evidence records them) point to TextInput or InputSearch for unlabelled chrome, OTP for codes, and FormUpload for files.

from.quote: TextInput or InputSearch for unlabelled chrome, OTP for codes, FormUpload for files.

evidenceFacts.name: FormField States
evidenceFacts.description: Set by the component from its props: invalid → Error; read only or disabled → Read Only; focused → Active; otherwise Idle. An explicit modes['FormField States'] overrides it.
evidenceFacts.quote: State cascade: invalid → Error; read-only or disabled → Read Only; focused → Active; otherwise Idle.

evidenceFacts.name: errorMessage
evidenceFacts.description: Replaces supportText only while isInvalid (or a Form error) is set; with isInvalid and no errorMessage, the support text turns red.
evidenceFacts.quote: `errorMessage` replaces `supportText` only while `isInvalid` (or a Form error) is set; with `isInvalid` and no `errorMessage`, the support text turns red.

evidenceFacts.name: isInvalid
evidenceFacts.description: Sets aria-invalid on the input, and aria-describedby points at the error message.
evidenceFacts.quote: The input has `aria-invalid` and `aria-required`, and `aria-describedby` points at the error

evidenceFacts.name: isRequired
evidenceFacts.description: Sets aria-required on the input; the asterisk uses the Negative token.
evidenceFacts.quote: The asterisk uses the Negative token (`mode/Negative/1400 (base)`).

evidenceFacts.name: supportText
evidenceFacts.description: Linked to the input (aria-describedby) while the field is valid.
evidenceFacts.quote: the support text is linked while the field is valid

evidenceFacts.name: isDisabled
evidenceFacts.description: Uses the Read Only colours at 50 % opacity rather than Figma's Disabled mode; sets aria-disabled and tabindex -1, so Tab skips the field.
evidenceFacts.quote: Disabled sets `aria-disabled` and `tabindex -1`, and Tab skips the field.

evidenceFacts.name: trailing
evidenceFacts.description: Not hidden from assistive tech on the web: a Button there stays in the tab order after the input and keeps its name.
evidenceFacts.quote: It stays in the tab order after the input and keeps its name; the slot is not hidden from assistive tech on the web.

evidenceFacts.name: type
evidenceFacts.description: password masks the value; email sets type=email; number sets inputmode=numeric.

evidenceFacts.name: accessibilityLabel
evidenceFacts.description: The input's accessible name is accessibilityLabel, then label, then the placeholder.
evidenceFacts.quote: the input's name is `accessibilityLabel`, then `label`, then the placeholder.

evidenceFacts.name: Color Mode
evidenceFacts.description: Dark renders identically to Light: Form Field has no dark values.
evidenceFacts.quote: Dark `Color Mode` renders identically to Light (no dark values).

gaps.text: Dark mode is not supported: Color Mode Dark renders like Light.

from.quote: Dark mode is not supported.

gaps.text: Disabled uses the read-only colours at half opacity instead of Figma's Disabled colours; the FormField States Disabled mode is never used.

from.quote: Disabled uses the read-only colours at half opacity instead of Figma’s Disabled colours.

gaps.text: No live region: an error is read when people reach the field, not when it appears.
gaps.quote: there is no live region, so an error is read when people reach the field, not when it appears.

gaps.text: The package field is 47 px tall; Figma's is 45 px.

from.quote: The package field is 47 px tall (45 px in Figma).
